newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Nykredit postpones flotation talks.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Nykredit postpones flotation talks.

text.p: Denmark's biggest mortgage credit institution Nykredit A/S said on Wednesday it decided to delay flotation talks on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange until it had finalised discussions on the future of its alliance with BG Bank and insurer Topdanmark.

"Nykredit's board has decided to put off further talks on a possible stock exchange flotation until the present deliberations about its own future and the development of its cooperation inside the alliance are finalised," Nykredit said in a statement.

Nykredit has a sales and marketing alliance with BG Bank - Denmark's third biggest bank - and Topdanmark - the country's third biggest insurer - and there has long been market talk that the three could merge.
Last June Nykredit said it was exploring options for a public offering and would announce its plans this spring.

BG Bank was formed out of merger between the former Bikuben savings bank and the post office giro bank in January 1996, involving a strategic alliance with Nykredit and Topdanmark. --Ole Mikkelsen, Copenhagen newsroom+45 33969654
